CRYPTO_TRADING.description: Deliberately coarse catch-all for the entire crypto/trading apparatus - no internal structure is preserved. Includes token buy and sell alerts across Solana, TON, Ethereum and BSC, new mint/launch/deployment announcements, DEX pair and screener feeds, LP burn and rugcheck alerts, sniper and MEV bots, airdrops, ATH and market-cap milestones, whale transfers, buy-bot group additions, futures signals, NFT sales, HYIP deposit schemes and crypto news aggregators. Fine topics not explicitly assigned elsewhere land here by construction.

members.summary: Notifications of coordinated X (Twitter) raid campaigns listing likes, retweets, replies, bookmarks, links and D.RAIDBOARD ranking/metrics for community-promoted posts.

CONSPIRACY_DEEPSTATE_ELITES.description: Agentic elite-conspiracy narratives - a hidden actor is doing this to you: QAnon and deep-state/white-hat military operations, Epstein documents, facial recognition and digital IDs, freemasonry, income-tax illegitimacy, the WHO pandemic treaty, globalist anti-vaccine framing, conspiracy-channel recruitment, plus the conspiratorial forms of antisemitism ('international Jewish mafia', underground tunnels/Chabad).

members.title: Deep State Military Conspiracy
members.summary: QAnon-style messages alleging a global 'deep state' cabal (CIA/elite financiers) runs world systems and that coordinated 'white hat' military operations, BRICS/foreign raids, and tech/financial disclosures will expose the cabal, trigger mass arrests, and restore a Trump-led order.

members.title: Jeffrey Epstein Documents
members.summary: Posts about unsealed Jeffrey Epstein documents alleging sex trafficking and misconduct involving high-profile figures (Clinton, Prince Andrew, Dershowitz, Branson, etc.), along with related lawsuits, denials, and media coverage.

members.title: QAnon and Conspiracy Channels
members.summary: Telegram posts promoting QAnon-style and other conspiracy theories (chemtrails, anti-Zionist/anti-establishment) that recruit users to channels like @Fraud_Inc and @davidavocadowolfe and use memes and donation/boost links (getmonero.org).

members.title: Income Tax Conspiracy Claims
members.summary: Posts promoting misinformation that U.S. law does not require paying income tax, citing alleged hidden footage and ex-IRS agents, plus claims of IRS misconduct and mass surveillance.

members.title: Facial Recognition & Digital IDs
members.summary: Discussion and activism opposing the expansion of facial recognition and biometric digital ID systems, highlighting government and private surveillance, data collection (passports, fingerprints), regulatory responses (EU AI Act, digital ID wallets), and calls to ban or restrict the technology.

members.title: International Jewish Mafia Conspiracy
members.summary: Bilingual messages promoting an antisemitic conspiracy that an "international Jewish mafia" controls governments, media, banks, vaccines and world events and urging people to "wake up".

members.title: Underground Tunnel Conspiracies
members.summary: Social posts and fringe-media claims about secret underground tunnel networks and D.U.M.B.S., alleging hidden military bases, child trafficking, and tunnels beneath NYC/Chabad locations.

members.title: Freemasonry Conspiracy Theories
members.summary: Cluster of messages alleging Freemasonry secretly infiltrates governments, institutions and elites, practices occult rituals and abuses, and is the focus of hostile, conspiratorial claims.

members.title: Anti-vaccine Globalist Conspiracy
members.summary: Messages accusing 'globalist' elites of harming society via COVID vaccines, promoting fear of 'parasites', and urging readers to print, share widely, and join anti-establishment groups.

members.title: Opposition to WHO Pandemic Treaty
members.summary: Discussion and mobilisation against the WHO Pandemic Treaty and proposed IHR amendments, framing them as a threat to national sovereignty, individual freedoms, and free speech and warning of enforced health measures and censorship.

IMMIGRATION_BORDERS.description: Border enforcement and anti-migrant discourse: US border and migrant-crisis framing, the Texas-federal standoff, migrant arrivals in US cities, anti-asylum messaging in Ireland.

members.title: Anti-Immigrant Messaging in Ireland
members.summary: Telegram/WhatsApp posts and shared content expressing hostility toward migrants and asylum seekers in Ireland, offering voting advice, promoting population-replacement and foreign-interference claims, and calling for local opposition to immigration.

members.title: U.S. Border and Immigration Crisis
members.summary: Messages center on illegal migration at the U.S. southern border, criticizing the Biden administration’s handling, promoting tougher enforcement and deportations (and Trump-era solutions), and highlighting related crime, migrant crossings, and border protests.

members.title: Texas Border Standoff
members.summary: Social posts backing Gov. Greg Abbott and the Texas National Guard in resisting federal orders to remove razor wire and defending state border sovereignty amid legal fights over immigration (SB4) and multi‑state GOP support.

members.title: Migrant Crisis in US Cities
members.summary: Reports and commentary about large influxes of migrants—particularly Haitian arrivals—overwhelming shelters and services in cities like Denver, Springfield, and New York City, prompting increased spending, evictions, shelter limits, and local backlash.

CONSPIRACY_PSEUDOSCIENCE.description: Conspiracies that dispute how the physical world works, with no single elite villain: flat earth, NASA and space-programme denial, chemtrails, graphene-oxide nanotech, EMF/5G harm, Antarctica secrets, ancient megalith/lost-civilisation claims, anti-evolution and reptilian discourse. Climate scepticism is not here: it has its own bucket, CONCERNS_ABOUT_CLIMATE_CHANGE_POLICIES.

members.title: Flat Earth Discussions
members.summary: Posts promoting, arguing for, and mocking flat-Earth views, sharing purported evidence (horizon/visibility, curvature/8in-per-mile claims), resources, and memes.

members.title: Graphene Oxide Nanotech Conspiracies
members.summary: Cluster of messages alleging graphene oxide and other nanotechnology are present in vaccines, rain and consumer items to enable brain-computer interfaces, bio-cyber surveillance, and related DARPA/Neuralink-linked control efforts.

members.title: EMF and 5G Protection
members.summary: Posts promoting a 'tested and proven' EMF/5G/WiFi radiation protection product and spreading anti-5G/EMF health claims while linking to herbalist/healing Telegram and Facebook groups.

members.title: NASA Conspiracy and Space News
members.summary: Messages combine recent spaceflight updates (SpaceX, NASA, international missions) with conspiracy theories alleging NASA deception and a fake Moon landing.

members.title: Ancient Pyramids and Megaliths
members.summary: Messages discuss discoveries, claims and speculative theories about ancient stone structures—pyramids, temples, caves and megaliths worldwide, often presented with sensational or conspiratorial framing.

members.title: Science Skepticism and Conspiracies
members.summary: Posts expressing skepticism and mockery of mainstream science—ranging from creationism vs. evolution debates and pharma/vaccine distrust to reptilian/lizard people conspiracy claims.

members.title: Antarctica Conspiracy Theories
members.summary: Cluster of messages promoting conspiracy claims about Antarctica — ice walls, hidden continents and civilizations, secret bases and restricted expeditions, and alleged suppression of maps and research.

members.title: Chemtrails Conspiracy Theories
members.summary: Messages asserting that persistent aircraft contrails are deliberate chemical 'chemtrails', featuring alleged evidence, eyewitness sightings, pilot/radar claims, and conspiracy commentary.

GEOPOLITICS_INTERSTATE.description: Interstate tension and generic war anticipation outside the two main theatres: China-Taiwan, North Korea military activity, Haitian gang/state collapse, and diffuse 'World War III is coming' discourse.

members.title: China-Taiwan Tensions
members.summary: Discussions and news on Beijing's sovereignty claims over Taiwan, rising cross-strait military and political developments, and related international security and diplomatic reactions.

members.title: North Korea Military Activity
members.summary: Discussion of North Korea's recent missile and drone launches, alleged attack plans and weapons production under Kim Jong Un, and the resulting military tensions and responses from South Korea and international actors.

members.title: Haiti gang violence crisis
members.summary: Posts discuss escalating gang violence and humanitarian collapse in Haiti, reporting attacks and migrant flows alongside calls for US/UN intervention and political or conspiracy commentary about foreign involvement.

members.title: US Warmongering and War Fears
members.summary: Cluster contains angry anti-war commentary accusing the U.S. and Western elites of instigating and prolonging conflicts, risking wider/global war and prioritizing power over peace.

PROTEST_MOBILIZATION.description: Online-to-offline collective action, deliberately detached from its parent conflicts: French/European farmers' protests, Southport stabbing riots in the UK, campus pro-Palestine encampments, global pro-Palestine marches, printed 'freedom' leaflet campaigns. Kept as one bucket so that mobilisation can be modelled as a distinct channel rather than as a subtopic of whatever people are protesting about.

members.title: French and European Farmers' Protests
members.summary: Farmers across France and neighboring European countries are mobilizing with tractor convoys and protests in Paris, Brussels and border areas to oppose government and EU policies and pressure leaders such as Macron.

members.title: UK Protests Over Southport Stabbing
members.summary: Widespread protests and riots across UK cities following the Southport stabbing, featuring clashes with police, attacks on mosques, arson, and rising anti-immigrant/anti-Muslim and far-right mobilization.

members.title: Campus Pro-Palestine Encampments
members.summary: Student-led pro-Palestinian encampments and protests at universities worldwide involving campus occupations, clashes with authorities, administrative suspensions, and controversies over antisemitism and solidarity actions.

members.title: Global Pro-Palestine Protests
members.summary: Reports of pro-Palestine demonstrations worldwide—mass rallies, solidarity actions, political interruptions, and counter-protests responding to the Gaza conflict and accusations of Israeli genocide.

members.title: Freedom Leaflet Distribution
members.summary: Telegram posts sharing printable 'freedom' leaflets and yellow-board ideas for local UK campaigns (Berkshire/Bracknell), urging distribution to oppose vaccines, 5G, climate policy and other government actions.

IDEOLOGY_ANTIESTABLISHMENT.description: Abstract ideological framing rather than event commentary: arguments over communism, socialism, fascism and democracy; patriot and propaganda rhetoric; derogatory liberal/leftist labelling; blanket distrust of politicians and government; alarmist national-decline appeals to Americans.

members.title: Communism, Socialism, Fascism
members.summary: Debates and insults about communism, socialism, capitalism and fascism—especially distinctions between socialism and national socialism/Nazism, claims equating fascism with corporatism, and extremist-adjacent rhetoric and misconceptions.

members.title: American Patriotism and Propaganda
members.summary: Cluster of messages celebrating U.S. patriots, veterans and national holidays while promoting religious blessings and anti-government/propaganda narratives.

members.title: Right Wing Anti-Liberal Rhetoric
members.summary: Messages feature insults and derogatory labels for liberals/leftists, debates over who qualifies as a liberal versus a conservative, and endorsement or justification of confrontational rhetoric toward progressives.

members.title: Political Corruption and Distrust
members.summary: Cluster of messages expressing anger and distrust toward politicians and government, accusing widespread corruption, calling for their removal or collapse, and criticizing state power and media control.

members.title: Critical Messages to Americans
members.summary: Cluster of alarmist, nationalistic, and sometimes profane posts addressing Americans, warning of national decline or conflict and urging patriotism or action.

MORAL_PANIC.description: Symbolic and moral conflicts rather than policy or war: abortion rights, gender-affirming care for minors, the Paris 2024 opening ceremony backlash, the Imane Khelif Olympic controversy, Taylor Swift/NFL conspiracies, anti-pedophile vigilantism.

members.title: Paris 2024 Opening Ceremony Backlash
members.summary: Widespread controversy and condemnation—particularly from religious figures and commentators—over the 2024 Paris Olympics opening ceremony, including allegations of blasphemy, calls to boycott, and removal of ceremony videos.

members.title: Taylor Swift NFL Conspiracies
members.summary: Cluster contains messages and links promoting conspiracies that Taylor Swift is connected to the NFL/Super Bowl (including Travis Kelce and the Chiefs), alleging rigging, psyops, satanic imagery, and child trafficking.

members.title: Abortion Rights and Restrictions
members.summary: Cluster of messages about abortion rights and restrictions, covering bans and legal rulings (e.g., Roe, state and international laws), regulation of abortion pills, demographic and policy changes, and polarized pro‑choice versus pro‑life reactions.

members.title: Opposition to Gender-Affirming Care
members.summary: Cluster criticizing gender-affirming medical treatments for minors and advocating bans, legal action, and child-protection against puberty blockers, hormones, and surgeries.

members.title: Anti-Pedophile Vigilantism
members.summary: Cluster of messages accusing individuals of pedophilia, sharing alleged cases and sightings, and promoting identification, protective measures, or vigilante/violent responses to defend children.

members.title: Imane Khelif Olympic Controversy
members.summary: Discussion centers on Algerian boxer Imane Khelif, who was disqualified by the International Boxing Association for having XY chromosomes and failing a testosterone test in 2023 yet cleared by the IOC to compete at the Paris Olympics, where her quick win over a female opponent ignited controversy about competitive fairness and athlete safety.

CRIME_POLICING_JUSTICE.description: Crime, policing and criminal justice: police shootings and killings, the Sean Combs indictment, alleged communal crimes against Hindus in India, firearms and ballistics discussion.

members.title: Police Shootings and Murders
members.summary: Cluster of messages reporting violent incidents—school shootings, attacks on officers, murders, related arrests, and legal developments involving firearms and police actions.

members.title: Sean Diddy Combs Indictment
members.summary: News and social-media discussion about Sean 'Diddy' Combs's arrest, grand-jury indictment and May 2025 trial over alleged sexual abuse, human trafficking, and related conspiracy claims.

members.title: Alleged Islamist Crimes Against Hindus
members.summary: Social-media posts alleging crimes and communal violence by Muslims—portraying 'love jihad', rape, forced conversions, mob attacks, and threats targeting Hindus.

members.title: Rifle Ballistics and Barrels
members.summary: Discussions about firearms—especially rifles and AR-15s—covering barrel length effects on velocity and noise, rifle vs pistol handling, ammunition types, and parts/pricing.

CONCERNS_ABOUT_CLIMATE_CHANGE_POLICIES.description: Opposition to and suspicion of climate and energy policy: climate-change scepticism mixed with geoengineering and weather-modification claims, and backlash against electric vehicles, wind and other renewables. Kept separate from CONSPIRACY_PSEUDOSCIENCE because a substantial share is ordinary policy, cost and energy-security criticism rather than a claim about how physics works - the two registers are mixed inside both fine topics.

members.title: Climate and Geoengineering
members.summary: Posts about climate change and geoengineering that mix discussion of weather modification and cloud seeding with skepticism and conspiracy-oriented claims about a 'climate hoax' and man-made warming.

members.title: EVs and Renewable Energy Concerns
members.summary: Discussion about Tesla and electric vehicles, battery safety and charging problems, and related renewable energy, storage reliability, and policy debates.

FREE_SPEECH_AND_CENSORSHIP.description: State and platform control of speech, and the resulting free-speech grievance: the US TikTok ban debate, Julian Assange's extradition and imprisonment as a press-freedom case, the arrest of Telegram founder Pavel Durov over moderation failures, the Brazil/Moraes suspension of X with VPN fines and arrests of Bolsonaro allies, and the court-driven bankruptcy and auction of Infowars read as the silencing of a dissident outlet. Bucket kept narrow: only cases where speech itself is the object of state or platform action. Adjacent themes deliberately left outside are surveillance and biometric ID (topic 197), censorship framing inside the WHO treaty debate (282), platform-restriction evasion mixed with invite spam (64) and generic media-control rhetoric (191).

members.title: TikTok Ban Debate
members.summary: Cluster of messages about U.S. efforts and political debate to ban TikTok, covering proposed bills, Trump joining the platform, privacy/national security concerns, and related conspiratorial claims.

members.title: Julian Assange Extradition Case
members.summary: Updates and commentary on Julian Assange’s extradition hearing, alleged plea deal and release, media coverage and public reactions regarding WikiLeaks and his imprisonment.

members.title: Pavel Durov Arrest in France
members.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov was arrested in France on allegations related to the messaging app’s role in criminal activity and moderation failures, triggering legal scrutiny, a Telegram privacy policy shift, and widespread international reaction.

members.title: Brazil Free Speech Crisis
members.summary: Messages discuss political unrest in Brazil centered on Supreme Court actions by Judge Alexandre de Moraes—protests over the suspension/ban of X (Twitter), VPN fines, arrests linked to Bolsonaro allies, and Elon Musk’s accusations of judicial election interference.

members.title: Infowars Bankruptcy and Sale
members.summary: Coverage of Alex Jones and Infowars focusing on legal and financial developments including bankruptcy proceedings, an auction sale (reported purchase by The Onion), emergency court filings, and related news analysis and broadcasts.

SCAMS_FRAUD_GRIFT.description: Fraud wearing a political skin, plus plain cybercrime: Trump-branded 'Never Surrender' coins, Liberty badges and Golden Eagles sold as guaranteed investments, stolen bank-account logs and fullz, and in-group scammer warnings. Politically flavoured monetisation of the same audience.

members.title: Never Surrender Gold Coins
members.summary: A flood of promotional messages pushing Trump-branded "Never Surrender"/Liberty coins that claim guaranteed massive bank-exchange returns, bulk bonus deals, and political endorsements with affiliate links.

members.title: Trump Liberty Badges Scam
members.summary: Spammy promotional messages touting "Trump Liberty"/"Golden" badges as limited-time investment opportunities with fraudulent claims of massive cash returns, urgent buy links, and pressure tactics.

members.title: Trump Golden Eagles Scam
members.summary: Coordinated promotional spam pushing 'Trump Golden Eagles' stickers/plates as a bogus investment that falsely promises massive guaranteed cash payouts and urges urgent purchases via suspicious links.

members.title: Scammer Warnings and Alerts
members.summary: Messages warning about suspected scammers and fake accounts on Telegram, sharing reports, cautions, and advice to avoid spam and fraud.

members.title: Compromised Bank Account Logs
members.summary: Cluster of Telegram posts advertising stolen bank account 'logs' and fullz—offering online/RDP access, debit card details and ATM PINs, SSNs/DOB/MMN, billing and carrier info, account balances and prices for sale via DMs.
